shortDescription: By Yantoultra NguiMalayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) MYX:MAYBANK, Malaysia's biggest bank by assets, plans to issue U.S. dollar senior unsecured notes, according to a term sheet seen on Tuesday.Here's more details:

children: , Malaysia's biggest bank by assets, plans to issue U.S. dollar senior unsecured notes, according to a term sheet seen on Tuesday.
The lender is marketing three-year tranche of floating-rate notes alongside five-year fixed-rate notes.
Initial price guidance for the three-year notes was set at about 90 basis points above the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR), a key U.S. benchmark used to price loans and bonds.
The five-year notes are being marketed at roughly 80 basis points above the yield on the five-year U.S. Treasury note.
The three-year notes will mature around September 15, 2029, while the five-year notes will mature on September 15, 2031.
Maybank plans to use the proceeds for working capital, general banking and other corporate purposes.
